source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 июля ст. ст. — «Мч. Аполлония (III).»

attestations.note: The day’s fourth entry, and this folder’s man: the same menologion day its Romanian and Greek rows already keep. THE EPITHET IS THE OTHER CITY AND THE READING RECONCILES THEM. Name page 242 heads him «Аполлоний Иконийский, мч.», of Iconium, where this folder’s own name and its Greek row say Sardis; the reading life4210 WAS OPENED and gives both — «Святой мученик Аполлоний происходил из города Сард, находившегося в Лидии», he came from Sardis in Lydia, and «Это произошло в Иконии», it happened at Iconium. One man, the city of his birth in one calendar and the city of his death in the other, and NOTHING WAS RENAMED. `dates` STILL NULL AND DELIBERATELY SO. The folder has never held a date; the line gives «(III)» and the reading closes «при императоре Декии (249-251) или Валериане (253-259)» — under Decius OR Valerian, two reigns offered as alternatives six years apart. A disjunction is not an interval, the source itself does not choose, and no `dates` object was written; the question is in the report. The reading also gives the manner: he refused to swear by the name of a mortal man, was long tortured and crucified. `types` UNCHANGED. No hymn on the day page stands under his name. TWO ENTRIES OF THIS DAY WERE WITHHELD AND ARE NAMED IN THE REPORT, both folders already carrying a VENERATED russian row on another Julian day: `anthony-of-the-caves` on 2 сентября (three hymns on this page left uncopied) and `silouan-of-the-kyiv-caves` on 10 июня — whose own row-note already records that his name page lists 10 июля as a day it did not read, and whose two hymns were taken there. BRIEF-RUSSIAN §4 forbids a draft on such a folder and BRIEF.md §4 sanctions a second-day note; the author has not ruled, so nothing was written for either. LEFT OUT of this day: «Положение честной ризы Господа нашего Иисуса Христа в Москве (1625)», the laying up of the Lord’s robe, which is a feast and not a person, with its troparion, kontakion and величание; and the Konevskaya icon with its two hymns.

saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Απολλώνιος από τις Σάρδεις»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 10 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the city in the Greek line is the folder's own byname: «Ο Άγιος Απολλώνιος καταγοταν από τις Σάρδεις». That, and the day, settle him against the corpus's three other men of the name — the companion of Proclus, the anchorite and the reader. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and the page prints no hymn under his line.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
